Replace only four measurement paragraphs, refresh exactly 29 documentation source pins, and preserve every prepared-package observation, existing evidence identity and unrelated inventory byte. Add registered live checks for all compact archive references, generated documentation and revision-pinned site links. Final required Core/hosted/recurring gates and the complete original VO #1220 scope remain separate.

Constructors and adapters compile with fresh Lean. Those unmodified prepared packages do not contain runtime entry counters. [Hosted entry probes](../evidence/php-wasm-entry-hosted-20261025/index.json) cover 30 ordinary/reviewed routes in 27 retained artifacts, plus the aggregate verifier artifact, at producer `a003269808c43a2a3a509a23c8a8ab8def07b610`. The 24 copied, owned and indexed routes count validator, constructor, adapter and Lean-source entries; six callback routes record callback control totals for Fin, selected Subtype and checked-record families. These separate instrumented fixture packages leave unmodified prepared packages and their supported types unchanged. The [promotion workflow](https://github.com/seanmorris/lean-bridge/actions/workflows/php-wasm-refinement-entry-promotion.yml) defines the complete matrix. PHP-Wasm accepts the listed structural containers, acyclic nominal fields, [finite recursive copied graphs](../evidence/recursive-subtype-php-wasm-20261015.md), and the tested [acyclic owned record](../evidence/owned-subtype-php-wasm-local-qualification-20261022.md). The owned-record checks preserve exact constructor choices, reject an invalid transferred value before moving its resources, exercise explicit and fallback cleanup, and recover on later requests across both source routes. Synchronous Fin, selected Subtype and checked-record callbacks use the separately documented installed-package paths. Retained/asynchronous refined callbacks and recursive owned graphs remain rejected. A consumer that does not declare checked support cannot read a verified refined component (`native-refinements-unavailable`). Python's [installed CI reports](../evidence/python-refinements-20261007/receipt.json) cover scalar and container `Fin`, top-level checked `Subtype`, and finite function specializations. Local acceptance does not establish a hosted CI result for a later revision.
